onboarding.howToSub: A quick tour of the main features
onboarding.s1body: Everything you need to run your NDIS support work — invoices, receipts, clients and tasks — in one place. Here's a quick tour.
onboarding.s2body: Snap a photo of any receipt. The app reads the merchant, date, GST and total automatically and files it for tax time.
onboarding.s3body: Build invoices with real NDIS support-item codes, automatic GST, and a live compliance checklist. Share a professional PDF in seconds.
onboarding.s4body: Keep participant profiles, care notes, documents and reminders together — and track spend against each participant's plan budget.
onboarding.s5body: Schedule tasks, events and shifts. Start a shift to auto-create draft invoices for the clients you support that day.
onboarding.s6body: Not sure which code to use? Ask the built-in AI assistant, or dictate notes with your voice in your own language.
onboarding.s7body: Every account starts with a free 14-day trial of everything you just saw — no card required. Keep going with Pro Monthly (A$19.99/mo) or Pro Yearly (A$199/yr), and cancel anytime.
